verdict.summary: The change closes the page-walk absence gap conservatively: each terminal-reap candidate receives a separately keyed, single-page ref/head corroboration, full or malformed responses defer instead of authorizing release, and the resulting pulls are passed through the existing worker-identity gate. The shared pull validator avoids duplicated trust checks, query inputs are bounded/encoded, and failures are scoped to the affected claim. The tests exercise exact request paths, multi-head accumulation, malformed/full-page refusals, identity filtering, positive retention, negative release, and per-claim deferral without relying on exceptions as kills. The documented deleted-head-plus-walk-skip residual is not introduced by this patch and the union strictly narrows the unsafe absence case. No diff-embedded reviewer-directed instruction was detected.
